name: Grizzled Bear Heart
summary: In Silverpine Forest, sturdy bears yield hearts for the Royal Apothecary Society's research into the New Plague.

sections.title: A Reagent for the New Plague
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society works without pause to create an engineered blight that can exterminate both the Scourge and living humanity. In Silverpine Forest's woodlands, Apothecary Renferrel found that toxins from a grizzled bear's heart make a remarkably lethal concoction when joined with arachnid ichor. Couriers and Forsaken loyalists hunt ferocious grizzled bears, giant grizzled bears, and the roaming beast Old Vicejaw. They carve out the hearts and carry them to Master Apothecary Faranell, deep within the Undercity's Apothecarium.

faq.q: What is a Grizzled Bear Heart used for?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society uses Grizzled Bear Hearts as experimental biological reagents. Apothecary Renferrel discovered that toxins from these hearts can be distilled into a lethal elixir for the Forsaken effort to brew the New Plague.

aliases: who do i give bear heart to
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest directs travelers to gather the hearts alongside Skittering Blood and deliver them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity's Apothecarium.

faq.q: Where do Grizzled Bear Hearts come from?
aliases: where do i find bear hearts
faq.answer: Grizzled Bear Hearts come from the bears roaming Silverpine Forest, including ferocious grizzled bears, giant grizzled bears, and the roaming beast Old Vicejaw.

faq.q: Why does the Royal Apothecary Society need natural animal toxins?
aliases: why do apothecaries use bear venom
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society seeks biological agents that can contaminate and destroy living flesh and undead physiology. The unique chemical properties in the heart tissues of Silverpine's hearty bears provide an ideal reactive base when blended with virulent spider blood.

angles.text: As Forsaken, harvesting these organs directly aids Master Apothecary Faranell in engineering a weapon against both Arthas's Scourge and the living mortals threatening Lordaeron.
As a hunter, tracking Silverpine's massive bears, including Old Vicejaw, tests your patience and field-dressing skill as you seek biological samples.
